name: Castpipe's Task
summary: In Ironforge, Master Mechanic Castpipe calls travelers to recover Gnomeregan's records. The ruined halls still hold vital mechanical and technical knowledge.

sections.title: A Call to Tinkertown
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell and was sealed under radioactive quarantine, its surviving gnomes found refuge in Ironforge's Tinkertown. Troggs and irradiated constructs still overrun their old home. Deep within the city, computing arrays hold operational records and mechanical schematics. Castpipe seeks outsiders willing to brave the toxic halls and recover files that may explain what went wrong or help the gnomes return.

sections.title: Assembly Endorsement
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences spreads word of Castpipe's effort. Castpipe belongs to no academic body, yet his fellow gnomes respect his skill and support his work. Rustfizzle puts the operation's strategic value at an eighty-four percent chance. Travelers can report to Tinkertown for orders.

faq.answer: Master Mechanic Castpipe is a respected gnomish engineer in Tinkertown, Ironforge. He organizes salvage teams to recover data from the underground ruins of Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why does Castpipe want data from Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: When Gnomeregan was contaminated and evacuated, its mainframe memory was left with critical technical knowledge, blueprints and internal system logs. The displaced gnomes need this information as they hope to rebuild.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome scholar with the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. He supports Castpipe's recovery effort and directs capable travelers to it.
Master Mechanic Castpipe can be found in Tinkertown, the gnome-settled district in Ironforge's eastern quarter.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Castpipe?
faq.answer: Reporting to Master Mechanic Castpipe leads to Data Rescue inside the fallen city. Travelers enter Gnomeregan's contaminated interior to recover computer punch cards and storage media.

faq.q: What is the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences?
faq.answer: The Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences is a respected gnomish society devoted to scientific, magical and mechanical study. Members such as Gaxim Rustfizzle use probability to assess important work.

angles.text: As a gnome, you help preserve a piece of your fallen home from radiation and destruction with each recovery effort. Castpipe's work touches your people's survival.
As an engineer, you know Gnomeregan's data cores hold computational marvels and advanced schematics unmatched elsewhere on Azeroth.
As an ally of the Alliance, you support displaced gnomes as they secure their lost archives. That work strengthens Tinkertown and the Alliance's technological standing.
